items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I became involved with Frank Winegard... who had a band called Frank Winegard and His Pennsylvanians... we played a place called the Village Barn.

ctx.x: The Republic, yeah. Where did you go from there?

Well, I think it was shortly after that that I became involved with Frank Winegard (PHONETIC), who had a band called Frank Winegard and His Pennsylvanians. And Frank had played at Young's Restaurant, which is another Chinese-American restaurant. There was a lot of those around and most of them used bands in those days, and they were all three sessions. You played noon, and then you played dinner and you played you know, supper. They were tough jobs. They didn't pay well and it was hard work. But Frank had played…
